No hard copies are mailed to Tsinghua for the Chinese Government Scholarship system application
award_holder_conditions: Scholarship recipients are notified by the university via email before July 31st of the year of admission
timeline_rules: Scholarship recipients are notified by the university via email before July 31st of the year of admission
The CSC system application may only be submitted once the applicant is informed by the pre-admitted department, so the department's decision precedes the scholarship deadline

official_contacts.general: Graduate Admissions Office, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084
official_contacts.email: grad@tsinghua.edu.cn; Department of Engineering Physics gwyjs@tsinghua.edu.cn; Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology hyyjyk@tsinghua.edu.cn

official.program_type: Intergovernmental scholarship (China Atomic Energy Authority and Ministry of Education)
official.coverage: Covers tuition fees, free university dormitory or an accommodation subsidy, a stipend and comprehensive medical insurance. The page does not itemise travel, visa or any other costs.
official.english_requirement: Proficiency in English (spoken, written and reading), with a valid certificate of language proficiency.
official.english_requirement_note: The page states the language requirement but names no test, score or minimum band.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Must apply to the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology at Tsinghua, in a listed nuclear or physics research direction; the scholarship is restricted to applicants from developing countries working on peaceful uses of nuclear energy
official.funding: Full scholarship - tuition fees; free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy; stipend; comprehensive medical

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are a non-PRC citizen in good health and committed to the nuclear industry
Confirm your prior degree is in a listed discipline: nuclear engineering, nuclear technology applications, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering or physics
Check the age limit: under 35 for a master's application, under 40 for a doctoral application
Obtain a valid English language proficiency certificate before you apply, since it is a stated eligibility condition
Apply to one of only two host units: the Department of Engineering Physics, or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology
Pick one of the nine listed research directions before you contact the department
Apply for pre-admission at https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin and secure the department's recommendation - the scholarship step cannot start without it
Register on the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System at http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn so you can submit the moment the department informs you
important_advice_for_students: The scholarship application cannot be submitted first. Pre-admission and a departmental recommendation come before anything else, so start with the department, not with the CSC system.
Wait for the department to inform you before opening the CSC application. Applying early in the system does not help, because the recommendation has to be in place.

Check your email constantly after applying to the department. An applicant who cannot be reached, or who does not complete the CSC online application in time, is treated as having renounced the candidacy.
Budget for the gap yourself. The page covers tuition, dormitory or an accommodation subsidy, a stipend and medical insurance, and publishes no stipend amount, no travel cover and no visa cover.

Do not rely on the record title. The live page is the 2024 edition; confirm with the Tsinghua Graduate Admissions Office that a current Atomic Energy cycle is running before you invest in the application.
common_rejection_risks: Applying to any Tsinghua department other than the two named nuclear units, which makes the recommendation step impossible
Applying to a major or research direction outside the published list
Exceeding the age limit of 35 for master's or 40 for doctoral study
Holding a degree outside the listed disciplines
Having no valid English proficiency certificate at the time of application
Missing or not checking the email from the pre-admitted department, and thereby losing the chance to submit in the CSC system in time
Assuming the scholarship page reflects the current cycle when it is the 2024 edition
estimated_uncovered_costs: International travel and airfare to China - not in the published coverage
Visa application and residence permit fees - not in the published coverage
Books, course materials and laboratory equipment - not in the published coverage
Any living cost above the stipend, which is not quantified on the page
Personal expenses during any period outside the published 2-3 or 3-4 year duration
document_audit: Valid English language proficiency certificate - the page requires it and does not name a test or score, so the issuing body's own certificate is what is stated
Evidence of a prior degree in a listed discipline
Evidence of meeting the age limit for the degree level applied for
Pre-admission confirmation from the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology

The Atomic Energy Scholarship page itself publishes no document list, no file format, no size limit and no translation rule; the document requirements sit with the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System, so confirm the required upload format there before you build your file set

referee_tracking.role: Tsinghua host department (Department of Engineering Physics or Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology)
referee_tracking.instructions: Not a referee in the academic sense. The page states the applicant must apply for pre-admission and reach the requirements of the department for a recommendation. The department also decides when to inform the applicant that the CSC system application may be submitted, so treat that contact as the trigger for the whole scholarship stage.

alerts.message: Confirm with the Tsinghua Graduate Admissions Office (grad@tsinghua.edu.cn, +86-10-62781380) or the China Scholarship Council that a current Atomic Energy cycle is running before you start the application.

alerts.trigger: The department must inform you before the CSC system application opens
alerts.message: Monitor your email from the department daily from the point you apply for pre-admission, and be ready to submit immediately.

alerts.trigger: Results are notified before July 31 of the year of admission
alerts.message: Plan your finances and travel for a late notification relative to the start of studies.

submission_workflow: Choose one of the two host departments, one of two majors, and one of nine research directions
Apply online for pre-admission at https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin
Meet the department's recommendation requirements and obtain the recommendation
Wait for the department's email informing you to complete the CSC application
Fill in and submit the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System application at http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn
Await university review, then assessment and decision by the China Atomic Energy Authority, the Ministry of Education and the China Scholarship Council
Receive notification by email before July 31 of the year of admission
post_award_requirements: The Atomic Energy Scholarship page publishes only one post-award rule: recipients are notified by email before July 31 of the year of admission. It publishes no annual review, no reporting requirement, no return-home obligation and no renewal rule.

The sibling Chinese Government Scholarship page on the same Tsinghua site states that annual review is strictly required for all CGS holders and that scholarship continuation depends on passing it. That rule is published on the CGS page, not on the Atomic Energy Scholarship page, so confirm whether it applies to this award before relying on it.
questions_to_ask_host: Is a 2026 Atomic Energy Scholarship cycle running, and what is the deadline for pre-admission in my department?
What does the department's recommendation step actually require, and how long does it take?
What is the stipend amount, and is it monthly or annual?
Is dormitory accommodation actually available, or is the accommodation subsidy the realistic outcome?
Are airfare, visa and travel costs covered from anywhere in the programme?
Does the Chinese Government Scholarship annual review apply to Atomic Energy Scholarship holders?
Is there any obligation to return to my home country after the award?

official.application_cycle: Call PPU 2027, enrolment in October 2027
official.deadline_central_display: The call for enrollment of students in October 2027 will be open from October 1st to November 16th, 2026
official.deadline_note: The call runs 1 October to 16 November 2026. Within that window each candidate and host laboratory must finalise a joint application, and in November candidates must choose one single project and programme.
official.status_note: The call opened on 1 October 2026 and closes on 16 November 2026, so applications are being accepted today. Host laboratories post their projects from 1 September on the application platform.
official.funding_period: per month, plus a one-off welcome bonus and annual travel reimbursement
official.funding_duration: Three years, on a three-year working contract
official.tuition_coverage_note: Students are employees of the Institut Pasteur on a three-year working contract, so the award is a salary rather than a separate tuition waiver.
official.funding_label: Paid three-year contract: EUR 2,000 per month plus benefits
benefits: Monthly salary of EUR 2,000 comprehensive of social benefits, including national health care and health insurance
One-off welcome bonus of EUR 4,000 gross, paid with the first salary
Reimbursement of one round-trip ticket per year to the country of origin, up to EUR 1,300 for non-continental European countries and up to EUR 350 for continental European countries
EUR 750 per year per student towards international conferences or summer courses
Assistance with accommodation in the first year
French language courses, Journal Club, oral presentation workshops and a Welcome Day
One-to-one meetings with the Dean and a thesis advisory committee
eligibility: Holder of a master's degree or equivalent in life sciences and/or medical sciences
Selected by a host laboratory, which chooses one candidate for its project
Must pass the application and interview procedures
A candidate cannot be selected for more than one project
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international candidates; the page refers to candidates from outside the European Community needing a hosting agreement for the visa, so no nationality restriction is published
official.international_eligibility: not stated as a restriction; the programme is explicitly international
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Research must be hosted in one of the Institut Pasteur's 150 or more laboratories, on a project posted on the application platform
official.application_method: Register on the application platform at https://ppu.pasteur.fr, choose up to four projects, and upload a detailed CV and a motivation letter in PDF. Advisors may request reference letters and may interview by video conference. The candidate then completes a joint application with the host laboratory. No applications by email are accepted.
requirements: Master's degree or equivalent in science, medicine or a related field
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed, normally in early February, with results communicated by mid-February
Candidates are first selected by host laboratories, then assessed by an ad hoc selection committee by mid-December
GRE scores are welcome but not required
No age restriction; most accepted candidates are 24 to 26
Candidates with external funding are eligible only if the funding constitutes employment or the funds can be allocated to the Institut Pasteur to pay the candidate's salary
documents: Detailed CV in PDF format
Motivation letter in PDF format
Reference letters, if requested by the advisor
official.english_requirement: The program is run in English and therefore fluency in English is required. TOEFL or other language proficiency scores are not necessary but may be indicated when submitting your application. No knowledge of French is required, but a basic knowledge may be useful in daily life outside the Institute.
official.english_requirement_note: English fluency is required but no test is mandatory; scores may optionally be supplied. French is not required.
selection_criteria: Candidates are first selected by host laboratories
Applications are then presented to an ad hoc selection committee by mid-December
All applicants are evaluated by the Admission Committee solely on the basis of their qualifications and scientific potential
official.duration: Three years, on a three-year working contract, with the PhD typically defended after three years
award_holder_conditions: Employment status with the Institut Pasteur on a three-year working contract
External funding must be assignable to the Institut Pasteur as salary
In November each year candidates must choose one single project and programme to continue the selection process
Travel reimbursement must be used within the academic year, with no postponement or refund
supplements_or_initiatives: Satellite programmes: PPU-IMAGINE, PPU-Participatory Science, PPU-OXFORD, PPU-Research and Technology, PPU-Emerging Infection Diseases and PPU-MD-PhD
PPU-IMAGINE selection is organised independently by Institut Imagine, whose PhD students receive Institut Imagine working contracts
PPU-OXFORD allows up to three months in the Chemistry Department of the University of Oxford
PPU-EID offers specific funding for thesis prolongation, mobility grants and congress participation
Funded in part by the European Union's Horizon 2020 programme under Marie Sklodowska-Curie grant agreement No 665807

official_contacts.general: Institut Pasteur, PPU programme office

official.description: The Pasteur-Paris University International doctoral programme funds PhD students at the Institut Pasteur through a three-year paid employment contract. Selected students receive a salary of EUR 2,000 per month including social benefits, a EUR 4,000 welcome bonus, annual return-travel reimbursement, and EUR 750 per year for conferences. The Call PPU 2027 is open from 1 October to 16 November 2026 for enrolment in October 2027.
official.program_type: Salaried doctoral contract (institutional research training programme)
official.coverage: Fully funded through employment: salary, social benefits, health insurance, welcome bonus, annual travel home and a conference allowance. No financial support is provided for family members.

application_readiness_checklist: Register on the PPU platform as soon as the projects are posted
Shortlist up to four projects across the satellite programmes
Prepare a detailed CV and a motivation letter, both in PDF
Identify referees in case an advisor asks for reference letters
Be ready for a video-conference interview in early February
common_rejection_risks: Applying after 16 November 2026
Choosing more than four projects, which the platform does not allow
Uploading the CV or motivation letter by email, which is not accepted
External funding that cannot be assigned as Institut Pasteur salary
estimated_uncovered_costs: Family members, for whom there is no financial support
Relocation costs beyond the annual travel reimbursement
Any cost above the monthly salary in high-cost Paris
document_audit: CV and motivation letter are PDFs on the platform, not email attachments
Host laboratory and project pairing is chosen on the platform
The single project and programme is selected in November

alerts.message: You must reduce to one single project and programme in November to stay in the selection process.

submission_workflow: Create a PPU platform account and browse projects from 1 September
Select up to four projects and contact laboratories if helpful
Upload a detailed CV and motivation letter in PDF
Await laboratory selection, then complete the joint application in November
Attend the committee interview in early February
Enrol in October 2027 on a three-year contract
